page.layout: Running head at top centre, page number at top left. Below it, two parallel chronological tables, left and right, each with year and text columns. Below the tables, centred, a woodcut ornament with no text. Catchword "HAC-" at the right below the ornament.

main_text.l: 5172. | 187 | Cleopatra & Anton.semel interfecsit:& Aegyptus fit Romana provincia. Lagidaei in Ægypto regnauerunt ann. CCXCV.

page.notes: The woodcut in the centre of the page is an ornamental cartouche with a grotesque mask; it is not text. The first table's year is printed "5172." and the second "5157."; the marginal number "56." sits at the far right of the second table. Some letters in the first table are blurred ("semel" may be printed "femel"). The "HAC-" catchword is printed at the right, below the woodcut.
